'''Alan Crawford''', also known as '''Scipio''', is a minor character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
Alan Crawford, at an unknown time, became involved in the music industry  and became the manager of the successful rapper [[Madd Dogg (3D Universe)|Madd Dogg]], helping him on his way to success.

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
{{Dialogue|p1=Alan|d1=Hey man, take me back to Dogg's mansion.|p2=Carl|d2=Not today, asshole. Today we're taking the scenic route, via the bottom of the ocean!|quotedetail=Alan being kidnapped by [[Carl Johnson]].}}
{{quote|Holy FUUUUUUUUUUCK!|Alan's last words. <small>(Mission: [[Management Issues]])</small>|sound=ManagementIssues-GTASA-AlanCrowford3.ogg}}

===Death===
A jealous [[OG Loc (3D Universe)|Jeffrey "OG Loc" Cross]], an aspiring rapper, hires [[Carl Johnson]] to [[Management Issues|kidnap and then kill]] Crawford in an attempt to sabotage Madd Dogg's career. Carl Johnson steals the [[Elegant]] scheduled to pick Crawford up and then, after an awards ceremony, drives the car into the nearby bay, bailing out just before the car enters the [[water]].

The death of Crawford sees Madd Dogg slowly turn to drugs and, as a consequence, becomes extremely depressed and [[Madd Dogg (mission)|attempts to kill himself]] after losing his [[Madd Dogg's Crib|mansion]] to [[Big Poppa]] of the [[Los Santos Vagos (3D Universe)|Los Santos Vagos]].

==Trivia==
*Crawford's murder is discussed on [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|WCTR]] and how it remains unsolved. However, [[Richard Burns]] opts out of reporting about the incident after claiming he felt it wasn't "very interesting".
*Crawford claims to know [[Ballas (3D Universe)|Ballas]] OGs, claiming that they are 'like brothers'.
*Similarly to several other characters of the game, Crawford's character model is not unique and instead shares the model with a [[Pedestrians|pedestrian]] commonly encountered in wealthy districts. The same applies to the woman that accompanies him during the mission.
**In addition, the character model as well as his clothing looks strikingly similar to American actor, [[wp:Cuba Gooding, Jr.|Cuba Gooding, Jr]]' in ''{{WP|Boyz in the Hood|Boyz n the Hood}}'', as the protagonist Tre Styles. ''Boyz n the Hood'' was a major influence on ''GTA San Andreas''' development.
*Crawford's character model is used on the movie poster for the film [[The Mainframe]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: Liberty City Stories]]''.
*According to CJ, Crawford appears to be 5 foot 3 inches tall.
